basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Ontario, I'm a 32-year-old avid gamer and sports enthusiast with a passion for collecting digital cards. By day, I work as a software developer, and in my free time, I indulge in my love for strategy games and online card collecting. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time with my close-knit group of friends, both online and offline. You can usually find me online during the evenings and weekends, as I navigate through digital adventures and partake in discussions about game strategies and card collections.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in technology and gaming, having pursued a degree in Computer Science and working in the software development industry for over a decade. My expertise extends to a deep understanding of game mechanics and online marketplaces, especially those related to digital card collections. I actively stay updated on the latest trends through self-learning and engaging with gaming communities.
